valueNote: A dated timeline with the club's own wording labelled as club voice gives more than a short news summary. Much of the page still restates AP and FC Barcelona releases, and some paragraphs describe the sources rather than Putellas.
summary: Approve. Every cited claim is confirmed on re-check, the ceremony date is Monday 26 October, and the salary sentence matches CBS. The closing meta sections are gone; the English reads as an editorial timeline with sourced quotes.
